description: Estimate yearly rewards minus annual, foreign and late fees for four small-business credit cards, given monthly spend, spend in the bonus category, share of spend abroad and late payments per year. Fees come from issuer pages a reviewer read and quoted; a fee with no current quote is marked not verified and left out of the ranking, never treated as zero. Excludes welcome bonuses, credits, interest and approval odds. Pay-in-full scenario, not personalized advice.

foreignSharePct.description: Percent of spend made abroad. Default 0.

monthlyBonusCategorySpend.description: Part of monthlySpend in a bonus category (for example shipping or advertising). Default 0.

monthlySpend.description: Business card spend per month in dollars. Default 5000.
